newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight mkt quiet at end week, no fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight mkt quiet at end week, no fixtures.

text.p: Business was calmer at the end of the week on the London sugar freight market with few new orders quoted, shipbrokers said on Friday.
CSR was still open with its earlier order for 40,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Queensland to Adabiya and 20,000 tonnes to Savannah/Gramercy.
But it entered the market again with a new order for 20,000 tonnes, again in bulk, from Queensland to Surabaya for August 5/15.
Shipbrokers said E D & F Man was close to fixing 25,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Paranagua to Black Sea/Baltic for July/August dates. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
